subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: After the shared timeout helper is restored, should OpenClaw allow an explicitly marked native compaction result to commit during the exact safety-timeout reason’s bounded settlement window?
rationale: The code can tightly scope and test the window, but accepting persistent session mutation after timeout cancellation is a runtime policy choice that automation cannot make safely.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Keep the exact-reason settlement window so completed compaction work can commit before the wrapper returns its terminal timeout result.

options.title: Keep timeout fail-closed
options.body: Preserve in-call partial summaries and improved guidance but remove AgentSession acceptance after the abort signal fires.

options.title: Require full live proof
options.body: Defer the policy choice until a slow-provider or full gateway run demonstrates recovery without late session mutation.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Keep the exact-reason settlement window so completed compaction work can commit before the wrapper returns its terminal timeout result.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to vincentkoc, and recent compaction history makes him the clearest available owner for this runtime policy decision.
